scope: All 60 wrong valid labels and 13 truncated replies retained in the frozen parent attempt failed/interrupted records. This separate addendum closes the qualitative omission documented by terminal review v2. It does not change scores, completion, publication, ranking or G-SIGNAL eligibility.

combinedCoverage.statement: Together with the unchanged terminal review v2, every retained wrong valid label, invalid model reply and truncated model reply in its 207 started records has a qualitative review. Infrastructure, cancelled and unattempted outcomes remain separately accounted; missing remote outcomes are not inferred.

independentReadOnlyCheck.reviewKind: independent read-only qualitative and mathematical check
verification: Every nonempty raw JSON reply parses, and its label/explanation fields equal the retained fields. Every such official label differs from the reference.
All 73 qualitative notes agree with the complete visible replies and supplied expressions/domains; all 13 empty replies have max_output_tokens and ceiling 4096.

Independently expanded and differentiated every integrated-curvature expression with Python standard-library Fraction arithmetic, recovering the recorded squared-root-polynomial certificates and both strict neither witnesses.
Independent degree-60 rational exponential bounds refine all three retained degree-40 softplus endpoint enclosures; center values and the strict negative interior neither witness agree.
Re-derived reciprocal curvature and interval/witness signs. The exact threshold is log(7/4), approximately 0.5596157879354227.

Rows 57 and 63 have visible mathematical errors but correct final curvature conclusions; their unresolved diagnosis does not imply a correct derivation or identify the cause of the wrong structured label.
Rows 13, 14, 70, 71, 72 accurately record the observed parity/degree/coefficient errors. The incorrect polynomial and minimum assertions cannot certify the supplied functions.
independentReadOnlyCheck.limitations: Failed-prefix screening evidence only; incomplete, provisional, unranked, and no G-SIGNAL. No official grade was repaired. No model/provider calls or repository changes occurred.

claimRestrictions: All records remain incomplete and their scores provisional; partial prefixes are not complete-cell scores or representative failure rates.
No publication, ranking, G-SIGNAL promotion or eligibility change follows from this addendum.
Wrong retained labels paired with correct written conclusions remain wrong labels, but their cause is unresolved; intermediate errors are noted separately.
No declared-frontier ID appears in the selected 73 outcomes. The original 11 dispatched frontier remote outcomes remain unknown, so no universal absence-of-error claim is supported.
Review is AI-assisted and concerns visible text only; it supplies no human approval or claim about hidden reasoning.
Private raw transcripts are not included. Diagnosis notes paraphrase visible evidence; retained private exports are required for full replay.
